Plugin.Name: Cache -> Array Share Control
Plugin.Overview: Changes only the user shares you select to a chosen primary pool (normally cache), secondary storage Array, and Mover action Pool -> Array, using Unraid's native /update.htm share-update interface. Creates a timestamped backup before every batch, verifies every applied change, rolls back completed changes if a later share fails, and can restore the most recent un-restored batch. Never runs Mover automatically.
